annotations.title: Query FX and accepted China histories

description: Query dated observations for a selected currency pair and optional accepted China annual series. Choose this for a time series, same-date FX cross, or observed-interval change; use world_markets_context for a chartless overview and money_market_context for funding-desk metrics. Read cached official FX reference histories and same-date currency crosses, with native units, provenance, age and observed-interval changes. Inspect owner-accepted Palimpsest China annual economic series and revision-aware history beside the CNY reference. Daily fixings, annual context and licensed gaps remain distinct. No collection, model fitting, executable quotes or scoring.

base.description: Base currency: each returned value is quote-currency units per one base unit. Must differ from quote.

china_series.description: Optional exact cn.wdi.* identifier from the response's china.series catalog. Omit to select the first accepted series, if available; never invent an ID or infer withheld values.

days.description: Calendar-day FX lookback from today, not an observation count. Only cached observations on shared dates are returned; gaps are not filled.

provider.description: Official FX reference source. Both currencies must be supported by this provider; the response lists its currencies.

quote.description: Quote currency for the selected pair's dated history; must be supported by provider and differ from base.

name: market_workbench

outputSchema.description: Dated reference FX history and accepted annual China structural evidence.
